title: The Astral Chart Companion
summary: A companion for the star-aligned past the courses that charts the foe in starlight and looses a volley or a mantle from the chart.

title: The Canon of the Quasar Heart
summary: A canon on kindling a bright quasar at the heart of the qi field and loosing it as a beam or as a surge to an ally.

title: The Nebula Veil Treatise
summary: A treatise of the Azure Sky halls on drawing a glowing veil of starlit mist that hides the body and bursts on command.

title: Manual of the Fixed Parallax
summary: A manual on shifting how the foe sees the star-bright strike so that it falls from an angle he did not guard.

title: The Gale-Sworn Azimuth Discipline
summary: A discipline of the Gale oath-schools that fixes a bearing on the foe by starlight and loosens a volley along it.

title: Treatise of the Long Ecliptic
summary: A treatise on the long path of starlight across the qi field that sweeps the foe and mantles the user.
